description: Validates that a background worker spec declares safe concurrency bounds, retry policy, dead-letter queue, timeout, image pinning, and queue bindings

rules.description: bg-worker-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare name, image, and a non-empty queues array
The container image must be pinned to a specific version tag or SHA digest. Mutable tags cause non-deterministic worker behaviour across restarts
Every queue entry must declare a name (the queue address) and a connection reference (the env var name pointing to the broker URL). A missing connection causes a runtime startup failure

A graceful shutdown period (terminationGracePeriodSeconds or shutdownTimeoutMs) must be declared. Without it, in-flight messages are interrupted mid-processing when the worker is restarted or scaled down
Background workers must not declare HTTP ports or expose a public endpoint. A worker with an exposed port is a service, not a worker, and belongs in a different compiler
When autoscaling is declared (hpa or keda), minReplicas must be >= 1 and maxReplicas must be > minReplicas. Zero minReplicas causes cold-start latency under burst load
rules.note: Skipped when no autoscaling config is declared

rules.description: bg-worker-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers

deadLetterQueue must be configured (messages exceeding maxRetries are silently dropped otherwise). owner is required for accountability. maxRetries must be a non-negative integer. concurrency must be declared to prevent resource exhaustion
rules.note: concurrency check can be skipped with skipConcurrencyCheck: true when broker enforces this externally
